_comment: Configuration used in our liver TACE MR/CT/DSA registration study. Each case folder holds ct/ven.nii.gz, mr/{ven,art}.nii.gz, dsa/run.npz (frames), dsa/meta.json (pixel_mm) and dsa/decomp.npz (windows = [t0, arterial start, arterial end, late start, n_frames]).

ctmr.title: CT <-> MR landmarks
ctmr.instructions: Left: CT venous phase, right: MR venous phase. Place 5-10 landmark pairs; skip structures you cannot identify.

left.title: CT
points: umbilical portion of left portal vein

right.title: MR
points: umbilical portion of left portal vein

dsa.title: MR <-> DSA arterial branch points
dsa.instructions: Left: MR arterial phase, right: DSA (darkest value over the arterial window). Place at least 3 pairs.

left.title: MR
points: first branch of left hepatic artery

right.title: DSA
points: first branch of left hepatic artery

contour.title: Tumour on MR, blush and liver margin on DSA
contour.instructions: Left: segment the 1-3 largest tumours. Right: draw every visible tumour blush (closed) and the liver margin (open).

artery.title: Hepatic artery on MR
artery.instructions: Segment the coeliac trunk, common/proper hepatic and left/right hepatic arteries with visible segmental branches; splenic artery and GDA only for the first 3 cm. Arteries are bright in the arterial phase (left) and dark in the venous phase (right); the portal vein is the opposite.
